newsitem.title: MALAWI: MALAWI BANS FOREIGN INVESTORS IN MINIBUS INDUSTRY.
newsitem.headline: MALAWI BANS FOREIGN INVESTORS IN MINIBUS INDUSTRY.

text.p: Malawi on Monday announced a ban on all foreign investors operating in the minibus taxi industry, citing the import of unroadworthy vehicles into the country.

Transport and Aviation Minister Harry Thomson told reporters in the commercial capital Blantyre that foreigners had capitalised on the country's liberalisation policy by bringing second-hand vehicles into the country.
"The various conditions of disrepair has been of concern to us -- Those vehicles are really not vehicles fit to be on the road," Thomson added.
Foreigners would still be allowed to invest in bus operations with a minimum capacity 40 passengers, he said.
